# simulator.pressKey

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Simulate a key press.

```lua
simulator.pressKey(key, duration)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | integer | yes |  |
| `duration` |  | yes | in seconds (number, optional) |

## Returns

Nothing.
